title: Smashed Tomato Pizza Sauce
headnote: A simple uncooked sauce for a wood-fired pizza oven. The source suggests trying it cooked first when using a pizza stone.

ingredientGroups.title: Sauce
items: ¼ tsp freshly ground black pepper

ingredientGroups.title: Optional additions
items: 1 tsp dried basil or 2 Tbsp fresh basil
2 Tbsp red wine vinegar or lemon juice

steps: Mash the tomatoes with a potato masher to a sauce consistency. Avoid a food processor or hand blender, which can break the seeds.
Mix in the pepper, salt and oregano, along with any optional additions.
Use uncooked on pizza for a wood-fired oven; the source suggests trying the sauce cooked first when baking on a pizza stone.
sourceNote: Adapted from Forno Bravo, Wood-Fired Pizza (2007), https://www.fornobravo.com/
